description: The chart consists of three pie charts, each representing different levels of difficulty in knowledge crosswords: easy, medium, and hard-shot. The easy pie chart has four slices with the following proportions: 55.4% for N-K+, 38.3% for N-K-, 4.6% for N-K, and 1.7% for N+K. The medium pie chart also has four slices with the following proportions: 58.8% for N-K+, 35.4% for N-K-, 4.0% for N-K, and 1.8% for N+K. The hard-shot pie chart has four slices with the following proportions: 37.3% for N-K+, 37.9% for N-K-, 18.1% for N-K, and 6.7% for N+K. Each pie chart includes a legend with color coding for the different categories, and the percentages are labeled inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
